object: electronic health record (EHR) interoperability certifications or native platform integrations specifically linking its negative pressure wound therapy devices directly with clinical hospital records
findings: The company reports the use of its iOn Progress Remote Therapy Monitoring System with the ActiV.A.C. Therapy Unit to monitor out-of-hospital negative pressure wound therapy patient adherence.

The company reports the availability of the Solventum V.A.C. Patient Support Application on Google Play and Apple App Store for U.S. patients to monitor therapy progress, track wound changes, and reorder supplies.
We verified that the company relies on its remote therapy monitoring system and patient support mobile application to track out-of-hospital adherence and progress.
